legend: You are given three integers n$$$n$$$, L$$$L$$$, and R$$$R$$$.
You need to do the following:
Pick an integer m$$$m$$$ such that 1≤m≤n$$$1 \leq m \leq n$$$;
Partition the interval [1,n]$$$[1, n]$$$ into m$$$m$$$ intervals [l1,r1],[l2,r2],…,[lm,rm]$$$[l_1, r_1], [l_2, r_2], \ldots, [l_m, r_m]$$$ such that:   l1=1$$$l_1 = 1$$$ and rm=n$$$r_m = n$$$;
li≤ri$$$l_i \leq r_i$$$ for all 1≤i≤m$$$1 \leq i \leq m$$$;
ri=li+1−1$$$r_i = l_{i+1} - 1$$$ for all 1≤i<m$$$1 \leq i  \lt  m$$$;

Note Pi=Πrilii$$$P_i= \Pi_{l_i}^{r_i}i$$$. Find the minimum of gcd(P1,P2,…,Pm)$$$\gcd(P_1, P_2,\ldots,P_m)$$$, and output your interval partition scheme. Here, gcd$$$\gcd$$$ means greatest common divisor.

For example, n=7$$$n=7$$$, L=3$$$L=3$$$ and R=4$$$R=4$$$, one optimal scheme is to choose m=2$$$m=2$$$ and intervals [1,4]$$$[1,4]$$$ and [5,7]$$$[5,7]$$$. In this case, gcd(P1,P2)=gcd(1⋅2⋅3⋅4,5⋅6⋅7)=gcd(24,210)=6$$$\gcd(P_1,P_2)=\gcd(1 \cdot 2 \cdot 3 \cdot 4,5 \cdot 6 \cdot 7)=\gcd(24,210)=6$$$, which can be proven to be the minimum value.

Since the value of gcd(P1,P2,…,Pm)$$$\gcd(P_1, P_2,\ldots,P_m)$$$ may be large, you need to output it modulo 998244353$$$998\,244\,353$$$. If there is not any valid interval partition scheme, output −1$$$-1$$$ instead.
input: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤104$$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$). The description of the test cases follows.
The only line of each test case contains three integers n$$$n$$$, L$$$L$$$, and R$$$R$$$ (1≤n≤105$$$1 \le n \le 10^5$$$, 1≤L≤R≤n$$$1 \le L \le R \le n$$$).
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 105$$$10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, if there is not any valid interval partition scheme, output −1$$$-1$$$.

Otherwise, in the first line output two integers m$$$m$$$ and g$$$g$$$, where m$$$m$$$ is the number of intervals and g$$$g$$$ is the minimum value of gcd(P1,P2,…,Pm)$$$\gcd(P_1, P_2,\ldots,P_m)$$$ modulo 998244353$$$998\,244\,353$$$.

In the following m$$$m$$$ lines, output two numbers li$$$l_i$$$ and ri$$$r_i$$$, representing the left and right endpoints of the intervals. The intervals must satisfy all the conditions in the statement.
If there are multiple answers, output any.
note: In the first test case, there is not any valid interval partition scheme.
In the second test case, the explanation is shown in the statement above.

legend.ai: 选取一个满足 1≤m≤n$$$1 \leq m \leq n$$$ 的整数 m$$$m$$$；
对所有 1≤i≤m$$$1 \leq i \leq m$$$，满足 li≤ri$$$l_i \leq r_i$$$；
满足 L≤ri−li+1≤R$$$L \leq r_i - l_i + 1 \leq R$$$。
记 Pi=Πrilii$$$P_i= \Pi_{l_i}^{r_i}i$$$。求 gcd(P1,P2,…,Pm)$$$\gcd(P_1, P_2,\ldots,P_m)$$$ 的最小值，并输出你的区间划分方案。这里，gcd$$$\gcd$$$ 表示最大公约数。

input.ai: 每组测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例数量 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤104$$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，如果不存在任何合法的区间划分方案，则输出 −1$$$-1$$$。
